title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
summary: Ricursive Intelligence is developing AI technology to automate the chip design process, allowing algorithms to learn and improve designs iteratively. This approach addresses the growing compute crisis by accelerating what has traditionally been a slow, manual process in semiconductor engineering.
content: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.

zh.title: 递归智能公司押注AI设计的芯片来帮助解决计算危机
zh.summary: 递归智能公司正在开发AI技术以自动化芯片设计流程，使算法能够迭代地学习和改进设计。这种方法通过加速传统上在半导体工程中缓慢的手动流程来解决日益严重的计算危机。

title: Flock CEO defends surveillance technology amid national backlash: ‘We shouldn’t pause progress’
summary: Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended the company's surveillance technology at TechCrunch Disrupt despite mounting privacy concerns, arguing that crime-fighting benefits justify potential abuse risks. The comments come as privacy advocates and the public increasingly scrutinize the technology's implications.
content: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended his company's surveillance technology despite growing privacy concerns, arguing that its crime-fighting benefits outweigh the risks of abuse.

zh.title: Flock首席执行官在全国强烈反对中为监控技术辩护：'我们不应该停止进步'
zh.summary: Flock首席执行官加勒特·兰利在TechCrunch Disrupt大会上为该公司的监控技术进行了辩护，尽管隐私担忧日益增加，他声称打击犯罪的好处证明了潜在的滥用风险是合理的。这些言论出现之际，隐私倡导者和公众越来越审视这项技术的影响。

title: Gudea leverages AI to help organizations prevent social media crises before they erupt
summary: Gudea uses AI to help organizations detect and prevent social media crises by tracking how stories and rumors spread online. The technology acts as an "internet storm tracker," identifying potentially damaging content before it escalates into major controversies.
content: Every day, conversations unfold across social media and websites around the world. A seemingly insignificant post—whether it involves AI-generated misinformation, hate speech, or a damaging rumor—can quickly snowball into a much larger public controversy. zh.summary: Gudea利用AI帮助组织检测并预防社交媒体危机，通过追踪故事和谣言在网络上的传播方式。该技术充当"互联网风暴追踪器"，在有潜在损害的内容升级为重大争议之前识别它们。
